name: LinkedIn Post Scraper
description: Fetch recent LinkedIn posts via the Profile API. Modes: posts (default, Voyager) scrapes personal profile posts. post_engagers extends posts with commenter data. feed_posts (DOM scraping) scrapes company pages, group feeds, or personal activity feeds — works where Voyager returns 403. Uses the same authenticated Chrome session as linkedin-profile-scraper.
usage_notes: Requires the Profile API (localhost:3847) with an active LinkedIn session. Default mode reads LinkedIn slugs from entity linkedin/linkedin_url field. Set source to 'profile_scraper' to read from linkedin-profile-scraper output instead (requires running that module first). Rate limited to avoid LinkedIn detection.

options.name: mode
options.label: Scraping mode
options.description: posts = personal profile posts via Voyager. post_engagers = posts + commenter data. feed_posts = company page / group / profile feed via DOM scraping (works where Voyager returns 403).

options.name: posts_per_profile
options.label: Posts per profile
options.description: Number of recent posts to fetch per profile/feed. Voyager modes (posts, post_engagers) cap at 25. feed_posts mode supports up to 200 (DOM scraping).

options.name: engagers_per_post
options.label: Engagers per post
options.description: Max commenters to fetch per post (post_engagers mode only). Each post costs 1 extra API call.

options.name: requests_per_hour
options.label: Requests per hour
options.description: Rate limit for API calls. Keep conservative (15-30) to avoid detection. In feed_posts mode each feed target costs 1 call (DOM scraping takes 30-120s per call).

options.name: min_word_count
options.label: Min post word count
options.description: Skip posts with fewer words than this (filters image-only or link-only posts).

options.name: source
options.label: Profile source
options.description: Where to find LinkedIn URLs: 'entity_field' reads from entity linkedin/linkedin_url field (supports /company/, /groups/, and /in/ URLs). 'profile_scraper' reads from linkedin-profile-scraper output (posts/post_engagers modes only).
